ruleset.name: RULESET_V3_M1
do_not: add tag cooldown / respawn / channel / suppression

scope.canonical_opponents_immutable: OP6-OP12 registry entries are not overwritten. Candidates are overlays.

A0.role: GUARD-demanding candidate (current, Gate B FAIL on this pole)

B0.role: BREACH-demanding anchor (Gate B PASS on this pole, delta=+0.531)

objective.immediate_job: find a better A; B stays OP7 unless a later generation beats it on delta_B without collapsing delta_G

screen_then_branch.current_pass: mutation_from_screen. OP6 frozen as GUARD_PAYOFF_CANDIDATE. 2500001 pristine. Complete-package miss on the static board justified mutation.
screen_then_branch.if_screen_finds_a_candidate: FREEZE that genome (and M1, intent definition, commitment definition, thresholds). Do NOT mutate around it looking for a prettier one. Search numbers are not evidence. Confirmation is a separate untouched run on block 2500001.
screen_then_branch.if_screen_finds_nothing: THEN mutation generations are justified. Still not Gate B.
do_not: combine search discovery and scientific confirmation
treat 8- or 16-episode deltas as Gate B

cheap_search.why_seed: fresh; 2300001 is the frozen M1 Gate B assay. Search seeds are not confirmation seeds.

confirmation_reserved.status: NOT AUTHORIZED until genomes are frozen by a human
confirmation_reserved.gate: GUARD(A)-BREACH(A) >= 0.15 AND LCB95>0 AND BREACH(B)-GUARD(B) >= 0.15 AND LCB95>0 AND t_reliable_intent > t_meaningful_commitment

observability.inputs: BLUE-legal only: visible enemy positions (engine home-side predicate on observed red x)
observability.t_reliable_intent: first step both live reds are on BLUE half and stay there for 4 consecutive steps
observability.t_meaningful_commitment: first step both live blues are on RED half (BREACH allocation already committed)
observability.why_not_7D_geometry_event: 7D used the same half-crossing as a treatment switch and was INVALID_TREATMENT_INSTANTIATION. Here it is a measurement on blue-visible state, never a controller switch.
